matches.quote: five parameters fitted to a single dispersion along one path... These parameters are strongly correlated... Report the fit covariance or correlation matrix
J⊥ and the claim of "three-dimensional antiferromagnetic order" rest on a gap near Γ... soften the "3D antiferromagnetic order" wording to "interlayer spin correlations".
The d_z² energy, 2.96 ± 0.58 eV, has an uncertainty too large to support "a possibly larger energy in the nickelate".
The mismatch of the d_xy intensity at H = 0.4 (σ) is attributed to Pr 5d or interstitial s states without a test.
Near Γ the magnon is at 60 to 80 meV... Alternative explanations the LSW fit does not exclude:... An artefact of the elastic/phonon subtraction.
Fig. 2(a) shows a sum of spectra over H = 0.4 to 0.475, across which the magnon disperses.
The magnon damping comparison does not isolate self-doping... Compare with a non-superconducting or differently reduced nickelate, or with literature NdNiO2/LaNiO2 damping.
The two films sit on different substrates (STO versus NGO), with different in-plane lattice constants... State the strain state of each film.
J⊥ is therefore constrained essentially by a handful of points near Γ... Show the Γ-point spectra and their decomposition explicitly.
Parameters for the single-ion calculations in Fig. 4(g–l) are not given: crystal-field values, spin–orbit, exchange field, broadening.
Damping in a 5 nm, topotactically reduced film can also come from disorder, residual or excess oxygen, stacking faults or strain inhomogeneity.
Δ = 8.00 eV, chosen "sufficiently larger than U also providing reasonable results"... With Δ chosen to give "reasonable results", it is not an independent test.

notes: C8 (apparent dispersion from varying weights of overlapping peaks) is raised in full detail by the review in P10 for the d_xy orbiton rather than the magnon, and in P12 for the magnon near Gamma; hence C8 is marked 'partly'. For C13, P8 raises the need to compare magnon damping with a non-superconducting nickelate reference, though it does not ask about the CCO resolution limit in Fig. 3(b).For C2, the review notes possible residual/excess oxygen (P8) and challenges the claim of absence of interstitial oxygen (P12, P16) without explicitly objecting to the phrase 'chemically undoped'. P2 and P3 are bare section headers from the review outline.
